name: Harem Residence
source:
Set in a fictional town of some fictional country, you take control of your average good guy. Recently losing your average job, and having nothing to do, your average parents sent you to take care of the not-so-average house of your recently deceased grandfather...

Seeing this as a fine opportunity to start again in another town, you move to your grandfather's house, and since it's pretty big and has a fair amount of empty rooms, you decide to make a living out of renting them~

The thing is this town has a high female-to-male ratio...
So your new tenants are all women!

[Edited from [url=https://vendena.itch.io/haremresidence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以某个虚构国家的虚构小镇为背景，你控制着普通的好人。最近失去了普通的工作，无事可做，你的普通父母派你去照顾刚去世的祖父的不那么普通的房子……

看到这是一个在另一个城市重新开始的好机会，你搬到了祖父家，因为房子很大，空房间也不少，你决定靠租房谋生~

问题是这个小镇的男女比例很高……
所以你的新房客都是女性！

[编辑自[url=https://vendena.itch.io/haremresidence]itch.io[/url]]
